title: September L. Davis: The Apology Tour at Studio Seaview #septemberldav...
transcript: Can addict, narcissist, and Broadway icon September L. Davis take accountability for her reprehensible actions? Probably not, but she's going to try. In this 100-minute cabaret comedy show currently running at Studio Seaview, September takes on the Herculean task of winning back our good graces after being cancelled by her Broadway nemesis, Ana Gasteyer. This production involves original music, much of which is pulled from her extensive list of Broadway credits. She also invites on stage various people she's wronged to apologize to them live, us bearing witness. What's funniest about this show is how, for one, even on a redemption arc, September cannot help but put others down — no one is safe, with Ed Sheeran, U Michigan, and Hamilton catching the most memorable strays. Secondly, her confessional storytelling is so oddly detailed, it's as if she's just spilling out a trail of intrusive thoughts — the media training is nowhere to be found. While sometimes a little slow, The Apology Tour is more often than not quite funny and occasionally hysterical. With that, another program for my collection.
